### New

- Open and save common 8-bit RGB Photoshop PSD files with raster layers and simple masks. PaintFE tells you when it opens a flattened preview and warns before a save that would lose editable content. Related to issue 246.
- Use a local RMBG 2.0 ONNX model for background removal. **Refine edges** adds an extra pass around uncertain edges on larger images. It takes longer and is off by default. Related to issue 247.

### Fixed

- Wide brush strokes drawn through MCP now fill in properly. Related to issue 245.
